stations.title: Ailsa
stations.say: Can every log line look the same?

stations.title: Callout log
stations.text: One tidy line: who, where and how many.

captions: Saturday callout. Ailsa wants every line of the callout log to look the same.
Today it is written by hand, and the call sign and the crew look different every time.
You build the line from text and a number, ending with one f-string.
Now the laptop writes one tidy entry: who, where and how many went out.
Text joined, tidied and filled in. Ailsa's log reads the same every night.
